{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module PaymentServer where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Pool
import Database.PostgreSQL.Simple
import Data.Text.Lazy (Text)
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy.Encoding as TLE
import Data.Aeson (FromJSON, ToJSON, decode)
import GHC.Generics
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Middleware.RequestLogger
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)

data PaymentRequest = PaymentRequest
  { amount :: Double
  , recipient :: String
  , memo :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON PaymentRequest
instance ToJSON PaymentRequest

data SessionInfo = SessionInfo
  { sessionUserId :: Int
  , sessionToken :: String
  , csrfToken :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- Connection pool configuration
mkPool :: IO (Pool Connection)
mkPool = do
  dbHost <- fromMaybe "localhost" <$> lookupEnv "DB_HOST"
  createPool
    (connect defaultConnectInfo { connectHost = dbHost, connectDatabase = "payments" })
    close
    4    -- stripes
    60   -- idle time
    20   -- max connections

-- Session validation middleware
validateSession :: Pool Connection -> Request -> IO (Maybe SessionInfo)
validateSession pool req = do
  let cookies = fromMaybe "" $ lookup "Cookie" (requestHeaders req)
  let sessionId = extractSessionId cookies
  case sessionId of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just sid -> withResource pool $ \conn -> do
      results <- query conn
        "SELECT user_id, session_token, csrf_token FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ? AND expires_at > NOW()"
        (Only sid)
      case results of
        [(uid, tok, csrf)] -> return $ Just (SessionInfo uid tok csrf)
        _ -> return Nothing

extractSessionId :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe String
extractSessionId cookies =
  let pairs = map (BS.break (== '=')) $ BS.split ';' cookies
  in lookup (BS.pack "session_id") [(BS.strip k, BS.unpack $ BS.drop 1 v) | (k, v) <- pairs]
  where
    -- Simple strip implementation
    -- BS.strip is available in newer bytestring

-- CSRF validation: compare Origin header against expected domain
-- This is the "defense" layer
validateCsrfOrigin :: Request -> Bool
validateCsrfOrigin req =
  let origin = lookup "Origin" (requestHeaders req)
      referer = lookup "Referer" (requestHeaders req)
  in case origin of
    Just o  -> BS.isPrefixOf "https://payments.example.com" o
    Nothing -> case referer of
      Just r  -> BS.isPrefixOf "https://payments.example.com" r
      Nothing -> True  -- Allow requests with no Origin/Referer (same-site navigation)

-- Token-based CSRF check
validateCsrfToken :: SessionInfo -> Request -> IO Bool
validateCsrfToken session req = do
  let headerToken = lookup "X-CSRF-Token" (requestHeaders req)
  case headerToken of
    Nothing -> return True  -- Skip token check if header not present
    Just t  -> return $ BS.unpack t == csrfToken session

-- Process payment with full validation chain
processPayment :: Pool Connection -> PaymentRequest -> SessionInfo -> IO (Either String String)
processPayment pool payReq session = do
  if amount payReq <= 0 || amount payReq > 10000
    then return $ Left "Invalid amount"
    else withResource pool $ \conn -> do
      execute conn
        "INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, amount, recipient, memo, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())"
        (sessionUserId session, amount payReq, recipient payReq, memo payReq)
      return $ Right "Payment processed successfully"

-- Main application
app :: IO ()
app = do
  pool <- mkPool
  scotty 8080 $ do
    middleware logStdoutDev

    -- GET endpoint to retrieve CSRF token
    get "/api/csrf-token" $ do
      req <- request
      mSession <- liftIO $ validateSession pool req
      case mSession of
        Nothing -> status status401 >> text "Unauthorized"
        Just session -> json $ object ["csrf_token" .= csrfToken session]

    -- POST endpoint for payment processing
    post "/api/payment" $ do
      req <- request
      mSession <- liftIO $ validateSession pool req
      case mSession of
        Nothing -> status status401 >> text "Unauthorized"
        Just session -> do
          -- Layer 1: Origin-based CSRF check
          let originValid = validateCsrfOrigin req
          -- Layer 2: Token-based CSRF check
          tokenValid <- liftIO $ validateCsrfToken session req
          if originValid && tokenValid
            then do
              body <- body
              case decode body of
                Nothing -> status status400 >> text "Invalid request body"
                Just payReq -> do
                  result <- liftIO $ processPayment pool payReq session
                  case result of
                    Left err -> status status400 >> text (TL.pack err)
                    Right msg -> text (TL.pack msg)
            else
              status status403 >> text "CSRF validation failed"
